## Testing

- [ ] `npm run test:ci:all` (or relevant `test:ci:*` areas)
- [ ] Large / behavioral change? Add label **`needs-e2e`** or leave triage to the **E2E triage agent** when the PR is marked ready.

When the PR is ready for review, CI runs **Functional acceptance (fixtures)** on every PR. Full **Obsidian E2E** runs when triage applies **`needs-e2e`** (automatic path rules, agent, or manual label).
